name: Sallie Mae
why: Largest U.S. private student lender; dossier already green.

name: Toyota Financial Services
why: Largest captive auto lender by accounts (Toyota and Lexus loans and leases).

name: Ally Auto
why: Largest U.S. bank auto lender by originations.

name: GM Financial
why: Major captive auto lender for Chevrolet, Buick, GMC and Cadillac. Picked over Capital One Auto Finance, whose public help pages do not cover auto-loan payments.

name: Ford Credit
why: Major captive auto lender for Ford and Lincoln loans and leases; has public Guest Pay.

name: Santander Consumer USA
why: One of the largest non-captive auto lenders (also services Chrysler Capital).

name: MOHELA (Federal Student Aid)
why: Largest federal student loan servicer. Nelnet and Aidvantage were considered, but their public help pages only load with scripts and could not be read.

name: OneMain Financial
why: Largest U.S. personal installment lender with a national branch network.

name: SoFi
why: Leading online personal loan and student loan refinance lender.

name: Discover Personal Loans
why: Large national personal loan servicer. Picked over Affirm, whose help center only loads with scripts and could not be read.

name: Credit Acceptance
why: One of the largest subprime auto lenders; public payment and AutoPay FAQ with a published fee table.

name: Westlake Financial
why: Large nationwide indirect auto lender; public customer FAQ lists every payment channel and fee.

name: Chase Auto
why: One of the largest bank auto lenders; public servicing FAQs cover payments, cutoffs, due dates and paperless.

name: Wells Fargo Auto
why: Major bank auto lender; public make-payments page and auto loan FAQs.

name: Upstart
why: Large online personal loan platform; public help center covers repayment and AutoPay.

name: LightStream
why: Truist's national online lender; public FAQ explains AutoPay vs invoice billing. The duplicate auto-loan entry was skipped.

name: Best Egg
why: Major online personal loan lender; public help center covers payments, auto pay and hardship.

name: Upgrade
why: Large online personal loan lender; public Payments & Billing help articles. Flex Pay entry skipped as the same company.

name: Prosper
why: Long-running peer-to-peer personal loan platform; public help center covers AutoPay, checks and due dates.

name: Nelnet (Federal Student Aid)
why: One of the largest federal Direct Loan servicers; its public FAQs (readable in a browser) cover payments, auto debit, eCorrespondence and deferment. Replaced Mariner Finance at review; the Mariner dossier stays as an extra.
